feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 4:30pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 26 November 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry for much of today, but cloudy, with fresh to strong southeast winds. Rain then arrives late this evening.

Rain continues overnight, turning heavy at times, with a minimum temperature around 4°C.

Comments: Strong winds. Risk of gales in exposed areas later. Coatal overtopping warning in place from 22:30 until 02:30 tomorrow, see warning for details.

Heavy rain warning overnight into Friday, see warning for details

Rain continues from Thursday night, turning heavy at times before clearing during Friday morning, leaving the rest of the day dry with sunny spells developing. Strong southeast winds will ease as the rain clears, becoming a light to moderate westerly, then southeast again later in the day. Top temperature 10°C.

Comments: Strong winds. Coastal overtopping warning in place until 02:30, see warning for details. Heavy rain - risk of localised flooding.


##Outlook##

A cloudy but dry start to Saturday, outbreaks of rain developing later in the afternoon. Moderate to fresh southeast winds, but strong in the north at first, gradually veering westerly through the afternoon. Top temperature 11°C.

Comments: Strong winds.
